coverage_check: League-wide screen of every right tackle: all 134 (2025) / 107 (2026) PFF tackle grades, every team's depth-chart RT starter (nflverse depth_charts 2025/2026) - 58 RT-side players - including reserve/IR (Bako-Bewele, Moton, Harrison), inactive (Lane Johnson, Spencer Brown, Blake Fisher, Charlie Heck) and free agents/retired (Conklin, Havenstein, Jonah Williams, Beachum, Pipkins). Side from depth-chart snapshots, not Madden. Zach Tom appears as Zach Bako-Bewele (same nflverse id 00-0037817). PAYWALLED GAPS: PFF pass/run-block sub-grades, pressures/sacks allowed (PFF+). Substitutes: ESPN OT PBWR (top 20)/RBWR (top 10) through Week 8, PFF overall + pass/run-block snaps, nflverse pbp penalties, snap counts, injury reports.
contention_basis: Judgment, not formula: 10 proposed top-10 right tackles plus first-outs Bako-Bewele, Moton and McGlinchey. Evidence: PFF overall (2025 + 2026 thru Week 8), pass/run-block snaps, ESPN OT win rates, penalties, RT depth-chart snapshots, availability.
